name: question_curation
content: You are a planning safety checker. A rewriter produced the clarified task below, along with candidate clarification questions.
Your job is to select only the questions that must be answered before planning can continue.
For each selected question, rewrite it as a concise, user-friendly question ending with a question mark.
- Only keep questions that unblock planning; drop optional or redundant ones.
- Preserve intent but improve clarity and tone.
- Provide a short rationale for each retained question so the planner knows why it matters.
- If no questions are needed, return an empty array.
Respond with STRICT JSON in this shape (double quotes everywhere):
Never include commentary outside the JSON payload.

variables.name: clarified_task
examples: Investigate the payment outage affecting EU customers and propose a roll-back plan.

variables.name: constraints
variables.description: Bullet list of currently known constraints.
examples:
- Must avoid contacting customer-facing teams
- Follow SOC2 guidelines

variables.name: candidate_questions
variables.description: Enumerated list of candidate clarification questions produced by the rewriter.
examples:
1. Which colo is affected?
2. Do we need legal sign-off?

variables.name: max_questions
variables.description: Maximum number of questions the planner is willing to ask right now.

metadata.description: Filters and rewrites candidate clarification questions so only critical user-facing asks remain.
metadata.author: MagicianV2
metadata.changelog: Initial version for clarification question curation.
